name: Iowa Native Plant Society Small Grants
summary: Small grants from a state native plant society to land managers and others for native-plant restoration and management projects, monitoring, research and training.

eligibility.rule: Carrying out the project in Iowa
Requesting no salaries or institutional/agency overhead

documents: Project description, up to 5 double-spaced pages

effort.quote: Submit it as an email attachment, or mail a paper copy to Molly McNicoll; see addresses on Application Form.
Proposals will be numerically rated according to the following 3 criteria, with a maximum of 5 points granted for each criterion

eligibility.quote: the project must be carried out in Iowa.
INPS does not fund plantings on bare ground.
Although services provided are eligible expenses, no funding will be granted for salaries for applicants, or for salaries at academic institutions or agencies, or institutional/agency overhead.

documents.quote: the Project Description (including the Background, Objectives, Methods, Significance of Work, and Qualifications of Agency or PI) should not exceed 5 double-spaced pages. Please include an itemized budget and budget justification.
